This '''battle''' was an early confrontation in the [[Tionese War]] between the young [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]]. Storming down the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tionese]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] came across [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]], then the farthest major Republic world from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], and took the planet.
